item.title: US troops brace for ‘hit-and-run’ guerilla attacks as 82nd Airborne deploys to Iran, military analyst warns
item.summary: The 82nd Airborne Division deployment to the Middle East is intended to pressure Iran into accepting U.S. ceasefire terms, military analyst Michael Eisenstadt says.

item.title: Fox News Poll: Voters oppose action in Iran but give US military positive marks
item.summary: A new poll finds 58% of voters oppose U.S. military action in Iran, while Trump's disapproval rating hits a second-term high of 59%, the survey shows.

item.title: Howie Mandel calls out Kelly Ripa’s backhanded compliment in tense live TV moment
item.summary: Howie Mandel called out Kelly Ripa and Mark Consuelos live on air, saying their age-based compliment was really an insult during his visit around his 70th birthday.

item.title: Arizona gun dealer armed two Mexican drug cartels, DOJ says
item.summary: An Arizona firearms dealer was indicted on charges of allegedly providing weapons to the CJNG and Sinaloa Cartel, both designated foreign terrorist organizations.

item.title: Illegal immigrant accused of fatal hit and run that killed North Carolina motorcyclist
item.summary: An illegal immigrant is accused of a fatal hit-and-run killing motorcyclist Christopher Babcock, 62, in North Carolina, with an ICE detainer lodged.

item.title: Kevin O'Leary says removing Iran from Strait of Hormuz would be a global 'game changer'
item.summary: 'Shark Tank' star Kevin O'Leary says removing Iranian control of the Strait of Hormuz would be a global game changer, calling the shift 'very bullish' for world markets.

item.title: Mom of ex-Yale swimmers alleges athletic department 'terrorized' women, 'emasculated' men: 'Like North Korea'
item.summary: Kim Jones, mother of three former Yale swimmers, alleges the athletic department intimidated female swimmers over transgender policies, comparing the experience to 'North Korea.'

item.title: 'Hunting Wives' star Brittany Snow stuns in bikini during 40th birthday desert celebration
item.summary: Brittany Snow turned 40 with a luxury desert Airbnb bash, stunning in a white bikini and turquoise silk gown while celebrating with her closest friends.

item.title: California Dems unleashed pressure campaign against USC prior to debate cancellation
item.summary: Top California Democrats pressed USC after its debate criteria produced an all-White lineup and left minority Democrats offstage, helping trigger the debate's cancellation, a GOP candidate claims.

item.title: Joe Flacco, 41, calls out 'dumb' NFL teams for not making him a starting quarterback
item.summary: Joe Flacco signed with the Cincinnati Bengals as a backup at age 41, saying he has "unfinished business" and still believes he deserves a starting role.
